messages:
Nadia: dropping a fresh copy of the 'mini-chronicle' row layout. want quick UX + a11y checks before dev handoff.

Nadia: figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/abc/mini-chronicle-v2 (page: row-compact)

Evan: looks good. suggestion: shrink the version pill and use an icon for canary vs active to save horizontal space.

Ruth: careful with icons-only. need visible label for screen readers and a tooltip on hover.

Sam: performance note: if we render traffic bars for every row it's heavy. show bars only when expanded or traffic > 2%.

Nadia: good call. i'll make bars conditional. also thinking about a collapsed state that groups versions by month.

Evan: grouping helps. also add a tiny hover preview with commit message and author. keyboard users need an equivalent (focus preview).

Ruth: a11y checklist: focus ring on rows, role=list + role=listitem, aria-expanded on chevrons, and announce the selected version via live region when changed.

Nadia: can you paste the suggested aria-live copy?

Ruth: use: "Version v2.3.1 selected. Traffic: 40%. Status: canary." in polite region.

Sam: copy nit for rollback CTA: change from "Rollback" to "Restore" per earlier conv. less alarmist.

Evan: agree. also add aria-label to the button: "Restore version v2.3.1".

A11yBot: Automated check: contrast fail on teal pill at 12px. Recommend darker #005f57 or bold text.

Nadia: thanks. action items: 1) swap "Rollback" -> "Restore" 2) conditional traffic bars 3) month grouping + load more 4) add aria-live message and focus behavior. i'll update figma and re-upload tonight.

Ruth: sounds good. Sam, can you look at virtualization implications in spike?

Sam: yes, i'll slot RED-3310 for perf spike.

Nadia: cheers everyone 389
